stories.headline: Amazon's AI spending drives a $42.4bn cash outflow
stories.summary: Amazon's trailing 12-month free cash flow fell to a $42.4 billion outflow despite AWS revenue growing 39% to $46 billion. Shares fell after hours. Strong cloud demand and heavy spending coexist; returns on that investment remain uncertain.

stories.headline: Foxconn says new OpenAI collaboration is in works
stories.summary: Foxconn's chairman says he met Sam Altman and is working on another OpenAI collaboration. Scope and terms remain undisclosed; no completed deal was announced. His rejection of an AI bubble is a company view, not an established market fact.

stories.headline: Binance reports $6.3bn theft; attribution disputed
stories.summary: Binance halted withdrawals after a $6.3 billion theft and says it will cover losses. TRM Labs and Chainalysis attribute the attack to North Korea; Binance says its own investigation has not assigned responsibility. Recovery and withdrawal timing remain uncertain.

stories.headline: DOJ expands election litigation before midterms
stories.summary: DOJ amended its Alaska lawsuit seeking to block certification after a narrow Republican loss and issued California subpoenas over alleged noncitizen voting. State officials contest the actions. Allegations remain disputed; election outcomes are not known.

stories.headline: Qatari mediators return to Tehran for peace push
stories.summary: An official says Qatari mediators returned to Tehran in a US-coordinated effort to reach a deal. Washington wants nuclear issues addressed early; Iran seeks an end to the port blockade and oil sanctions first. No agreement has been announced.
